rider.title: DingoGo: Rides & Parcels
rider.short: Local rides and same-day parcels in Alice Springs. Fixed price before you book.
rider.full:
DingoGo is an Aboriginal-owned rideshare and courier service in Alice Springs (Mparntwe), run by locals and going electric.

RIDES
- See the fixed price before you book, with GST and the NT levy included.
- Book now or for later: airport, hospital, shops, work or home.
- Electric and hybrid cars are offered first when they're close by.
- Pay by card, DingoGo credit or a business account.
- Share your trip with family so they can follow the car live.
- Trip PIN so you know you're in the right car, and an emergency button.

PARCELS
- Same-day delivery across town, with photo or signature on delivery.
- The recipient gets a tracking link and can leave a note for the driver.

MADE FOR EVERYONE
- Simple mode with big buttons, pictures and read-aloud.
- Wheelchair-friendly cars and assistance animals welcome.
- Plain English, with Arrernte, Warlpiri, Pitjantjatjara and Luritja words where we can.

REWARDS
- Earn points on every trip and use them on fares.
- Gift vouchers and café rewards with local businesses.

DingoGo is local: drivers keep 75% of the fare and 100% of tips. Our fleet is going electric, one car at a time.

Questions? Visit our website or call us. Privacy policy: https://dingogo-steel.vercel.app/legal/privacy

driver.title: DingoGo Driver
driver.short: Drive with DingoGo in Alice Springs. Keep 75% of every fare and all your tips.
driver.full:
DingoGo Driver is the app for approved drivers with DingoGo, the Aboriginal-owned rideshare and courier service in Alice Springs (Mparntwe).

EARN
- Keep 75% of every fare and 100% of tips.
- See what you'll earn before you accept a trip.
- Weekly earnings, GST figures for your BAS and tax invoices in the app.

DRIVE
- Trip offers near you, with pickup, drop-off and pay on one screen.
- Open the route in Google Maps or Waze.
- Rider PIN at pickup, emergency help and trusted contacts.
- Keeps working with poor signal: your trip updates wait on your phone and send when signal returns.

YOUR CAR AND PAPERS
- Upload your licence, accreditation and car papers, with reminders before they expire.
- Own car (any fuel, within the NT age limit) or a DingoGo fleet car.
- Charging log for electric cars.

LOOKING AFTER YOU
- Fatigue breaks, leave for Sorry Business and family, and a sun-friendly high-contrast theme.

Location: DingoGo Driver uses your location while the app is open and you're online or on a trip, to offer you nearby trips and show your rider where you are. It explains this before your phone asks.

To drive, apply on our website first. Privacy policy: https://dingogo-steel.vercel.app/legal/privacy
